name: Alfa Romeo 159/Brera 2.4 JTDM 20v (5-cyl diesel)
source: Alfa Romeo 18,000 mi / 12 mo schedule (alfaworkshop.co.uk) with cambelt at specialist-recommended interval.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes & pipes, handbrake cables, subframe/suspension corrosion, bushes, springs)
items.notes: Past MOTs: rear subframe and arms corroded, brake pipes corroded, broken coil spring (2020). Check the underside closely.

items.name: Cambelt, tensioner, idlers, water pump & aux belt
items.notes: Alfa's official interval is 5 years / 87k (140,000 km). Specialists advise 4 years / 60k. Interference engine: a snapped belt wrecks it.

items.name: DPF / emissions check
items.notes: Failed on smoke in 2022, and the tester queried whether the DPF has been modified.
